verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a public REST or HTTP API for Bitbucket. The only nearby items are a vague marketing line, 'Build custom integrations', which is adjacent and not a documented API, and an MCP server, which belongs to a different story. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs at support.atlassian.com all returned 404, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
